title: Scenario capture requirements
responsibility: Expands required evidence across applicable states and viewports and separates missing from inapplicable states.

inputs.name: scenarioRequirements.scenario
inputs.description: Scenario manifest containing state coverage, evidence requirements and named viewports.

outputs.name: scenarioRequirements
outputs.description: Required capture combinations only for required evidence on required states, plus unproven missing states and excluded inapplicable states with reasons. Evidence without viewports produces one requirement per state.
